title: Ask HN: Any other blind devs interested in working on dev tools for the blind?
guide_zh: 一年失去四份工作的盲人开发者，寻找伙伴共同改进面向盲人的开发工具。
author: blinddev
excerpt: Just lost my fourth job this year. I can't definitively claim it is because of my blindness, I may just not be very good at software development. But one thing is for sure, there are many dev tools that are either hard or impossible to use if you're blind. I'm looking at you JIRA, GitLab, Chrome Dev Tools, etc. I'm tired of feeling helpless. I want to build tools that make my life easier. Any other blind devs in the same boat who would be interested in collaborating?
